# azurefilesacl_avd_session_host_cleanup_marker (Resource)

Marker resource that deletes stale Azure Virtual Desktop session-host artifacts when Terraform destroys the marker.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_pool_id` (String) ARM resource ID of the Azure Virtual Desktop host pool.
- `resource_group_name` (String) Resource group name that contains the session-host VM.
- `session_host_name` (String) Session-host VM name and AVD sessionHost child-resource name.

### Optional

- `allow_current_vm_present` (Boolean) Allow cleanup to run when a same-name Azure VM exists. Usually false for destroy markers. Defaults to false.
- `cleanup_avd_session_host` (Boolean) Delete the AVD broker sessionHost record and associated userSessions during marker destroy. Defaults to false.
- `cleanup_entra_device` (Boolean) Delete matching Microsoft Entra device objects during marker destroy. Defaults to false.
- `cleanup_intune_managed_device` (Boolean) Delete matching Microsoft Intune managedDevice objects during marker destroy. Defaults to false.
- `current_vm_id` (String) Azure Compute VM instance GUID that is allowed to exist during cleanup. Usually omitted for destroy markers.
- `force_user_sessions` (Boolean) Delete active AVD userSessions before deleting the sessionHost record. Defaults to false.
- `require_vm_absent` (Boolean) Fail without deleting artifacts when the Azure VM still exists. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
